passages.label: Mart. 13.1.1
passages.text: Ne toga cordylis et paenula desit olivis

passages.label: Mart. 13.1.2
passages.text: Aut inopem metuat sordida blatta famem,

passages.label: Mart. 13.1.3
passages.text: Perdite Niliacas, Musae, mea damna, papyros:

passages.label: Mart. 13.1.4
passages.text: Postulat, ecce, novos ebria bruma sales.

passages.label: Mart. 13.1.5
passages.text: Non mea magnanimo depugnat tessera telo,

passages.label: Mart. 13.1.6
passages.text: Senio nec nostrum cum cane quassat ebur:

passages.label: Mart. 13.1.7
passages.text: Haec mihi charta nuces, haec est mihi charta fritillus:

passages.label: Mart. 13.1.8
passages.text: Alea nec damnum nec facit ista lucrum.

passages.label: Mart. 13.2.1
passages.text: Nasutus sis usque licet, sis denique nasus,

passages.label: Mart. 13.2.2
passages.text: Quantum noluerat ferre rogatus Atlans,

passages.label: Mart. 13.2.3
passages.text: Et possis ipsum tu deridere Latinum:

passages.label: Mart. 13.2.4
passages.text: Non potes in nugas dicere plura meas,

passages.label: Mart. 13.2.5
passages.text: Ipse ego quam dixi. Quid dentem dente iuvabit

passages.label: Mart. 13.2.6
passages.text: Rodere? carne opus est, si satur esse velis.

passages.label: Mart. 13.2.7
passages.text: Ne perdas operam: qui se mirantur, in illos

passages.label: Mart. 13.2.8
passages.text: Virus habe, nos haec novimus esse nihil.

passages.label: Mart. 13.2.9
passages.text: Non tamen hoc nimium nihil est, si candidus aure,

passages.label: Mart. 13.2.10
passages.text: Nec matutina si mihi fronte venis.

passages.label: Mart. 13.3.1
passages.text: Omnis in hoc gracili Xeniorum turba libello

passages.label: Mart. 13.3.2
passages.text: Constabit nummis quattuor empta tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 13.3.3
passages.text: Quattuor est nimium? poterit constare duobus,

passages.label: Mart. 13.3.4
passages.text: Et faciet lucrum bybliopola Tryphon.

passages.label: Mart. 13.3.5
passages.text: Haec licet hospitibus pro munere disticha mittas,

passages.label: Mart. 13.3.6
passages.text: Si tibi tam rarus, quam mihi, nummus erit.

passages.label: Mart. 13.3.7
passages.text: Addita per titulos sua nomina rebus habebis:

passages.label: Mart. 13.3.8
passages.text: Praetereas, si quid non facit ad stomachum.

passages.label: Mart. 13.4.1
passages.text: Serus ut aetheriae Germanicus imperet aulae

passages.label: Mart. 13.4.2
passages.text: Utque diu terris, da pia tura Iovi.

passages.label: Mart. 13.5.1
passages.text: Cerea quae patulo lucet ficedula lumbo,

passages.label: Mart. 13.5.2
passages.text: Cum tibi sorte datur, si sapis, adde piper.

passages.label: Mart. 13.6.1
passages.text: Nos alicam, poterit mulsum tibi mittere dives.

passages.label: Mart. 13.6.2
passages.text: Si tibi noluerit mittere dives, emes.

passages.label: Mart. 13.7.1
passages.text: Si spumet rubra conchis tibi pallida testa,

passages.label: Mart. 13.7.2
passages.text: Lautorum cenis saepe negare potes.

passages.label: Mart. 13.8.1
passages.text: Inbue plebeias Clusinis pultibus ollas,

passages.label: Mart. 13.8.2
passages.text: Ut satur in vacuis dulcia musta bibas.

passages.label: Mart. 13.9.1
passages.text: Accipe Niliacam, Pelusia munera, lentem:

passages.label: Mart. 13.9.2
passages.text: Vilior est alica, carior illa faba.

passages.label: Mart. 13.10.1
passages.text: Nec dotes similae possis numerare nec usus,

passages.label: Mart. 13.10.2
passages.text: Pistori totiens cum sit et apta coco.

passages.label: Mart. 13.11.1
passages.text: Mulio quod non det tacituris, accipe, mulis.

passages.label: Mart. 13.11.2
passages.text: Haec ego coponi, non tibi dona dedi.

passages.label: Mart. 13.12.1
passages.text: Tercentum Libyci modios de messe coloni

passages.label: Mart. 13.12.2
passages.text: Sume, suburbanus ne moriatur ager.

passages.label: Mart. 13.13.1
passages.text: Ut sapiant fatuae, fabrorum prandia, betae,

passages.label: Mart. 13.13.2
passages.text: O quam saepe petet vina piperque cocus!

passages.label: Mart. 13.14.1
passages.text: Cludere quae cenas lactuca solebat avorum,

passages.label: Mart. 13.14.2
passages.text: Dic mihi, cur nostras inchoat illa dapes?

passages.label: Mart. 13.15.1
passages.text: Si vicina tibi Nomento rura coluntur,

passages.label: Mart. 13.15.2
passages.text: Ad villam moneo, rustice, ligna feras.

passages.label: Mart. 13.16.1
passages.text: Haec tibi brumali gaudentia frigore rapa

passages.label: Mart. 13.16.2
passages.text: Quae damus, in caelo Romulus esse solet.

passages.label: Mart. 13.17.1
passages.text: Ne tibi pallentes moveant fastidia caules,

passages.label: Mart. 13.17.2
passages.text: Nitrata viridis brassica fiat aqua.

passages.label: Mart. 13.18.1
passages.text: Fila Tarentini graviter redolentia porri

passages.label: Mart. 13.18.2
passages.text: Edisti quotiens, oscula clusa dato.

passages.label: Mart. 13.19.1
passages.text: Mittit praecipuos nemoralis Aricia porros:

passages.label: Mart. 13.19.2
passages.text: In niveo virides stipite cerne comas.

passages.label: Mart. 13.20.1
passages.text: Hos Amiternus ager felicibus educat hortis:

passages.label: Mart. 13.20.2
passages.text: Nursinas poteris parcius esse pilas.

passages.label: Mart. 13.21.1
passages.text: Mollis in aequorea quae crevit spina Ravenna,

passages.label: Mart. 13.21.2
passages.text: Non erit incultis gratior asparagis.

passages.label: Mart. 13.22.1
passages.text: Non habilis cyathis et inutilis uva Lyaeo,

passages.label: Mart. 13.22.2
passages.text: Sed non potanti me tibi nectar ero.

passages.label: Mart. 13.23.1
passages.text: Chia seni similis Baccho, quem Setia misit,

passages.label: Mart. 13.23.2
passages.text: Ipsa merum secum portat et ipsa salem.

passages.label: Mart. 13.24.1
passages.text: Si tibi Cecropio saturata Cydonea melle

passages.label: Mart. 13.24.2
passages.text: Ponentur, dicas: 'Haec melimela placent.'

passages.label: Mart. 13.25.1
passages.text: Poma sumus Cybeles: procul hinc discede, viator,

passages.label: Mart. 13.25.2
passages.text: Ne cadat in miserum nostra ruina caput.

passages.label: Mart. 13.26.1
passages.text: Sorba sumus, molles nimium tendentia ventres:

passages.label: Mart. 13.26.2
passages.text: Aptius haec puero, quam tibi, poma dabis.

passages.label: Mart. 13.27.1
passages.text: Aurea porrigitur Iani caryota Kalendis;

passages.label: Mart. 13.27.2
passages.text: Sed tamen hoc munus pauperis esse solet.

passages.label: Mart. 13.28.1
passages.text: Haec tibi quae torta venerunt condita meta,

passages.label: Mart. 13.28.2
passages.text: Si maiora forent cottana, ficus erat.

passages.label: Mart. 13.29.1
passages.text: Pruna peregrinae carie rugosa senectae

passages.label: Mart. 13.29.2
passages.text: Sume: solent duri solvere ventris onus.

passages.label: Mart. 13.30.1
passages.text: Caseus Etruscae signatus imagine Lunae

passages.label: Mart. 13.30.2
passages.text: Praestabit pueris prandia mille tuis.

passages.label: Mart. 13.31.1
passages.text: Si sine carne voles ientacula sumere frugi,

passages.label: Mart. 13.31.2
passages.text: Haec tibi Vestino de grege massa venit.

passages.label: Mart. 13.32.1
passages.text: Non quemcumque focum nec fumum caseus omnem,

passages.label: Mart. 13.32.2
passages.text: Sed Velabrensem qui bibit, ille sapit.

passages.label: Mart. 13.33.1
passages.text: Trebula nos genuit; commendat gratia duplex,

passages.label: Mart. 13.33.2
passages.text: Sive levi flamma, sive domamur aqua.

passages.label: Mart. 13.34.1
passages.text: Cum sit anus coniunx et sint tibi mortua membra,

passages.label: Mart. 13.34.2
passages.text: Nil aliud bulbis quam satur esse potes.

passages.label: Mart. 13.35.1
passages.text: Filia Picenae venio Lucanica porcae:

passages.label: Mart. 13.35.2
passages.text: Pultibus hinc niveis grata corona datur.

passages.label: Mart. 13.36.1
passages.text: Haec, quae Picenis venit subducta trapetis,

passages.label: Mart. 13.36.2
passages.text: Inchoat atque eadem finit oliva dapes.

passages.label: Mart. 13.37.1
passages.text: Aut Corcyraei sunt haec de frondibus horti,

passages.label: Mart. 13.37.2
passages.text: Aut haec Massyli poma draconis erant.

passages.label: Mart. 13.38.1
passages.text: Subripuit pastor quae nondum stantibus haedis

passages.label: Mart. 13.38.2
passages.text: De primo matrum lacte colustra damus.

passages.label: Mart. 13.39.1
passages.text: Lascivum pecus et viridi non utile Baccho

passages.label: Mart. 13.39.2
passages.text: Det poenas; nocuit iam tener ille deo.

passages.label: Mart. 13.40.1
passages.text: Candida si croceos circumfluit unda vitellos,

passages.label: Mart. 13.40.2
passages.text: Hesperius scombri temperet ova liquor.

passages.label: Mart. 13.41.1
passages.text: Lacte mero pastum pigrae mihi matris alumnum

passages.label: Mart. 13.41.2
passages.text: Ponat, et Aetolo de sue dives edat.

passages.label: Mart. 13.42.1
passages.text: Non tibi de Libycis tubures et apyrina ramis,

passages.label: Mart. 13.42.2
passages.text: De Nomentanis sed damus arboribus.

passages.label: Mart. 13.43.1
passages.text: Lecta suburbanis mittuntur apyrina ramis

passages.label: Mart. 13.43.2
passages.text: Et vernae tubures. Quid tibi cum Libycis?

passages.label: Mart. 13.44.1
passages.text: Esse putes nondum sumen: sic ubere largo

passages.label: Mart. 13.44.2
passages.text: Et fluit et vivo lacte papilla tumet.

passages.label: Mart. 13.45.1
passages.text: Si Libycae nobis volucres et Phasides essent,

passages.label: Mart. 13.45.2
passages.text: Acciperes, at nunc accipe chortis aves.

passages.label: Mart. 13.46.1
passages.text: Vilia maternis fueramus Persica ramis:

passages.label: Mart. 13.46.2
passages.text: Nunc in adoptivis Persica cara sumus.

passages.label: Mart. 13.47.1
passages.text: Picentina Ceres niveo sic nectare crescit,

passages.label: Mart. 13.47.2
passages.text: Ut levis accepta spongia turget aqua.

passages.label: Mart. 13.48.1
passages.text: Argentum atque aurum facilest laenamque togamque

passages.label: Mart. 13.48.2
passages.text: Mittere: boletos mittere difficilest.

passages.label: Mart. 13.49.1
passages.text: Cum me ficus alat, cum pascar dulcibus uvis,

passages.label: Mart. 13.49.2
passages.text: Cur potius nomen non dedit uva mihi?

passages.label: Mart. 13.50.1
passages.text: Rumpimus altricem tenero quae vertice terram

passages.label: Mart. 13.50.2
passages.text: Tubera, boletis poma secunda sumus.

passages.label: Mart. 13.51.1
passages.text: Texta rosis fortasse tibi vel divite nardo,

passages.label: Mart. 13.51.2
passages.text: At mihi de turdis facta corona placet.

passages.label: Mart. 13.52.1
passages.text: Tota quidem ponatur anas; sed pectore tantum

passages.label: Mart. 13.52.2
passages.text: Et cervice sapit: cetera redde coco.

passages.label: Mart. 13.53.1
passages.text: Cum pinguis mihi turtur erit, lactuca valebis:

passages.label: Mart. 13.53.2
passages.text: Et cocleas tibi habe. Perdere nolo famem.

passages.label: Mart. 13.54.1
passages.text: Cerretana mihi fiat vel missa licebit

passages.label: Mart. 13.54.2
passages.text: De Menapis: lauti de petasone vorent.

passages.label: Mart. 13.55.1
passages.text: Musteus est: propera, caros nec differ amicos.

passages.label: Mart. 13.55.2
passages.text: Nam mihi cum vetulo sit petasone nihil.

passages.label: Mart. 13.56.1
passages.text: Te fortasse magis capiat de virgine porca;

passages.label: Mart. 13.56.2
passages.text: Me materna gravi de sue volva capit.

passages.label: Mart. 13.57.1
passages.text: Niliacum ridebis holus lanasque sequaces,

passages.label: Mart. 13.57.2
passages.text: Inproba cum morsu fila manuque trahes.

passages.label: Mart. 13.58.1
passages.text: Aspice, quam tumeat magno iecur ansere maius!

passages.label: Mart. 13.58.2
passages.text: Miratus dices: 'Hoc, rogo, crevit ubi?'

passages.label: Mart. 13.59.1
passages.text: Tota mihi dormitur hiems et pinguior illo

passages.label: Mart. 13.59.2
passages.text: Tempore sum, quo me nil nisi somnus alit.

passages.label: Mart. 13.60.1
passages.text: Gaudet in effossis habitare cuniculus antris.

passages.label: Mart. 13.60.2
passages.text: Monstravit tacitas hostibus ille vias.

passages.label: Mart. 13.61.1
passages.text: Inter sapores fertur alitum primus

passages.label: Mart. 13.61.2
passages.text: Ionicarum gustus attagenarum.

passages.label: Mart. 13.62.1
passages.text: Pascitur et dulci facilis gallina farina,

passages.label: Mart. 13.62.2
passages.text: Pascitur et tenebris. Ingeniosa gula est.

passages.label: Mart. 13.63.1
passages.text: Ne nimis exhausto macresceret inguine gallus,

passages.label: Mart. 13.63.2
passages.text: Amisit testes. Nunc mihi gallus erit.

passages.label: Mart. 13.64.1
passages.text: Succumbit sterili frustra gallina marito.

passages.label: Mart. 13.64.2
passages.text: Hunc matris Cybeles esse decebat avem.

passages.label: Mart. 13.65.1
passages.text: Ponitur Ausoniis avis haec rarissima mensis:

passages.label: Mart. 13.65.2
passages.text: Hanc in piscina ludere saepe soles.

passages.label: Mart. 13.66.1
passages.text: Ne violes teneras periuro dente columbas,

passages.label: Mart. 13.66.2
passages.text: Tradita si Gnidiae sunt tibi sacra deae.

passages.label: Mart. 13.67.1
passages.text: Inguina torquati tardant hebetantque palumbi:

passages.label: Mart. 13.67.2
passages.text: Non edat hanc volucrem qui cupit esse salax.

passages.label: Mart. 13.68.1
passages.text: Galbina decipitur calamis et retibus ales,

passages.label: Mart. 13.68.2
passages.text: Turget adhuc viridi cum rudis uva mero.

passages.label: Mart. 13.69.1
passages.text: Pannonicas nobis numquam dedit Umbria cattas:

passages.label: Mart. 13.69.2
passages.text: Mavult haec dominae mittere dona Pudens.

passages.label: Mart. 13.70.1
passages.text: Miraris, quotiens gemmantis explicat alas,

passages.label: Mart. 13.70.2
passages.text: Et potes hunc saevo tradere, dure, coco?

passages.label: Mart. 13.71.1
passages.text: Dat mihi pinna rubens nomen, sed lingua gulosis

passages.label: Mart. 13.71.2
passages.text: Nostra sapit. Quid si garrula lingua foret?

passages.label: Mart. 13.72.1
passages.text: Argoa primum sum transportata carina:

passages.label: Mart. 13.72.2
passages.text: Ante mihi notum nil nisi Phasis erat.

passages.label: Mart. 13.73.1
passages.text: Ansere Romano quamvis satur Hannibal esset,

passages.label: Mart. 13.73.2
passages.text: Ipse suas numquam barbarus edit aves.

passages.label: Mart. 13.74.1
passages.text: Haec servavit avis Tarpei templa Tonantis.

passages.label: Mart. 13.74.2
passages.text: Miraris? Nondum fecerat illa deus.

passages.label: Mart. 13.75.1
passages.text: Turbabis versus nec littera tota volabit,

passages.label: Mart. 13.75.2
passages.text: Unam perdideris si Palamedis avem.

passages.label: Mart. 13.76.1
passages.text: Rustica sim an perdix, quid refert, si sapor idem est?

passages.label: Mart. 13.76.2
passages.text: Carior est perdix. Sic sapit illa magis.

passages.label: Mart. 13.77.1
passages.text: Dulcia defecta modulatur carmina lingua

passages.label: Mart. 13.77.2
passages.text: Cantator cycnus funeris ipse sui.

passages.label: Mart. 13.78.1
passages.text: Nomen habet magni volucris tam parva gigantis?

passages.label: Mart. 13.78.2
passages.text: Et nomen prasini Porphyrionis habet.

passages.label: Mart. 13.79.1
passages.text: Spirat in advecto, sed iam piger, aequore mullus;

passages.label: Mart. 13.79.2
passages.text: Languescit. Vivum da mare: fortis erit.

passages.label: Mart. 13.80.1
passages.text: Quae natat in Siculo grandis muraena profundo,

passages.label: Mart. 13.80.2
passages.text: Non valet exustam mergere sole cutem.

passages.label: Mart. 13.81.1
passages.text: Quamvis lata gerat patella rhombum,

passages.label: Mart. 13.81.2
passages.text: Rhombus latior est tamen patella.

passages.label: Mart. 13.82.1
passages.text: Ebria Baiano veni modo concha Lucrino:

passages.label: Mart. 13.82.2
passages.text: Nobile nunc sitio luxuriosa garum.

passages.label: Mart. 13.83.1
passages.text: Caeruleus nos Liris amat, quem silva Maricae

passages.label: Mart. 13.83.2
passages.text: Protegit: hinc squillae maxima turba sumus.

passages.label: Mart. 13.84.1
passages.text: Hic scarus, aequoreis qui venit adesus ab undis,

passages.label: Mart. 13.84.2
passages.text: Visceribus bonus est, cetera vile sapit.

passages.label: Mart. 13.85.1
passages.text: Princeps Niliaci raperis, coracine, macelli:

passages.label: Mart. 13.85.2
passages.text: Pellaeae prior est gloria nulla gulae.

passages.label: Mart. 13.86.1
passages.text: Iste licet digitos testudine pungat acuta,

passages.label: Mart. 13.86.2
passages.text: Cortice deposita mollis echinus erit.

passages.label: Mart. 13.87.1
passages.text: Sanguine de nostro tinctas, ingrate, lacernas

passages.label: Mart. 13.87.2
passages.text: Induis, et non est hoc satis, esca sumus.

passages.label: Mart. 13.88.1
passages.text: In Venetis sint lauta licet convivia terris,

passages.label: Mart. 13.88.2
passages.text: Principium cenae gobius esse solet.

passages.label: Mart. 13.89.1
passages.text: Laneus Euganei lupus excipit ora Timavi,

passages.label: Mart. 13.89.2
passages.text: Aequoreo dulces cum sale pastus aquas.

passages.label: Mart. 13.90.1
passages.text: Non omnis laudes pretiumque aurata meretur,

passages.label: Mart. 13.90.2
passages.text: Sed cui solus erit concha Lucrina cibus.

passages.label: Mart. 13.91.1
passages.text: Ad Palatinas acipensem mittite mensas:

passages.label: Mart. 13.91.2
passages.text: Ambrosias ornent munera rara dapes.

passages.label: Mart. 13.92.1
passages.text: Inter aves turdus, si quid me iudice certum est,

passages.label: Mart. 13.92.2
passages.text: Inter quadripedes mattea prima lepus.

passages.label: Mart. 13.93.1
passages.text: Qui Diomedeis metuendus saetiger agris

passages.label: Mart. 13.93.2
passages.text: Aetola cecidit cuspide, talis erat.

passages.label: Mart. 13.94.1
passages.text: Dente timetur aper, defendunt cornua cervum:

passages.label: Mart. 13.94.2
passages.text: Inbelles dammae quid, nisi praeda, sumus?

passages.label: Mart. 13.95.1
passages.text: Matutinarum non ultima praeda ferarum

passages.label: Mart. 13.95.2
passages.text: Saevos oryx constat quot mihi morte canum!

passages.label: Mart. 13.96.1
passages.text: Hic erat ille tuo domitus, Cyparisse, capistro.

passages.label: Mart. 13.96.2
passages.text: An magis iste tuus, Silvia, cervus erat?

passages.label: Mart. 13.97.1
passages.text: Dum tener est onager solaque lalisio matre

passages.label: Mart. 13.97.2
passages.text: Pascitur, hoc infans, sed breve nomen habet.

passages.label: Mart. 13.98.1
passages.text: Pendentem summa capream de rupe videbis

passages.label: Mart. 13.98.2
passages.text: Casuram speres; despicit illa canes.

passages.label: Mart. 13.99.1
passages.text: Delicium parvo donabis dorcada nato:

passages.label: Mart. 13.99.2
passages.text: Iactatis solet hanc mittere turba togis.

passages.label: Mart. 13.100.1
passages.text: Pulcher adest onager: mitti venatio debet

passages.label: Mart. 13.100.2
passages.text: Dentis Erythraei: iam removete sinus.

passages.label: Mart. 13.101.1
passages.text: Hoc tibi Campani sudavit baca Venafri:

passages.label: Mart. 13.101.2
passages.text: Unguentum quotiens sumis, et istud olet.

passages.label: Mart. 13.102.1
passages.text: Expirantis adhuc scombri de sanguine primo

passages.label: Mart. 13.102.2
passages.text: Accipe fastosum, munera cara, garum.

passages.label: Mart. 13.103.1
passages.text: Antipolitani, fateor, sum filia thynni:

passages.label: Mart. 13.103.2
passages.text: Essem si scombri, non tibi missa forem.

passages.label: Mart. 13.104.1
passages.text: Hoc tibi Thesei populatrix misit Hymetti

passages.label: Mart. 13.104.2
passages.text: Pallados a silvis nobile nectar apis.

passages.label: Mart. 13.105.1
passages.text: Cum dederis Siculos mediae de collibus Hyblae,

passages.label: Mart. 13.105.2
passages.text: Cecropios dicas tu licet esse favos.

passages.label: Mart. 13.106.1
passages.text: Gnosia Minoae genuit vindemia Cretae

passages.label: Mart. 13.106.2
passages.text: Hoc tibi, quod mulsum pauperis esse solet.

passages.label: Mart. 13.107.1
passages.text: Haec de vitifera venisse picata Vienna

passages.label: Mart. 13.107.2
passages.text: Ne dubites, misit Romulus ipse mihi.

passages.label: Mart. 13.108.1
passages.text: Attica nectareum turbatis mella Falernum.

passages.label: Mart. 13.108.2
passages.text: Misceri decet hoc a Ganymede merum.

passages.label: Mart. 13.109.1
passages.text: Hoc de Caesareis mitis vindemia cellis

passages.label: Mart. 13.109.2
passages.text: Misit, Iuleo quae sibi monte placet.

passages.label: Mart. 13.110.1
passages.text: Surrentina bibis? nec murrina picta nec aurum

passages.label: Mart. 13.110.2
passages.text: Sume: dabunt calices haec tibi vina suos.

passages.label: Mart. 13.111.1
passages.text: De Sinuessanis venerunt Massica prelis:

passages.label: Mart. 13.111.2
passages.text: Condita quo quaeris consule? Nullus erat.

passages.label: Mart. 13.112.1
passages.text: Pendula Pomptinos quae spectat Setia campos,

passages.label: Mart. 13.112.2
passages.text: Exigua vetulos misit ab urbe cados.

passages.label: Mart. 13.113.1
passages.text: Haec Fundana tulit felix autumnus Opimi.

passages.label: Mart. 13.113.2
passages.text: Expressit mustum consul et ipse bibit.

passages.label: Mart. 13.114.1
passages.text: Non sum de primo, fateor, Trifolina Lyaeo,

passages.label: Mart. 13.114.2
passages.text: Inter vina tamen septima vitis ero.

passages.label: Mart. 13.115.1
passages.text: Caecuba Fundanis generosa cocuntur Amyclis,

passages.label: Mart. 13.115.2
passages.text: Vitis et in media nata palude viret.

passages.label: Mart. 13.116.1
passages.text: Potabis liquidum Signina morantia ventrem?

passages.label: Mart. 13.116.2
passages.text: Ne nimium sistant, sit tibi parca sitis.

passages.label: Mart. 13.117.1
passages.text: Amphora Nestorea tibi Mamertina senecta

passages.label: Mart. 13.117.2
passages.text: Si detur, quodvis nomen habere potest.

passages.label: Mart. 13.118.1
passages.text: Tarraco, Campano tantum cessura Lyaeo,

passages.label: Mart. 13.118.2
passages.text: Haec genuit Tuscis aemula vina cadis.

passages.label: Mart. 13.119.1
passages.text: Nomentana meum tibi dat vindemia Bacchum:

passages.label: Mart. 13.119.2
passages.text: Si te Quintus amat, commodiora bibes.

passages.label: Mart. 13.120.1
passages.text: De Spoletinis quae sunt cariosa lagonis

passages.label: Mart. 13.120.2
passages.text: Malueris, quam si musta Falerna bibas.

passages.label: Mart. 13.121.1
passages.text: Marsica Paeligni mittunt turbata coloni:

passages.label: Mart. 13.121.2
passages.text: Non tu, libertus sed bibat illa tuus.

passages.label: Mart. 13.122.1
passages.text: Amphora Niliaci non sit tibi vilis aceti:

passages.label: Mart. 13.122.2
passages.text: Esset cum vinum, vilior illa fuit.

passages.label: Mart. 13.123.1
passages.text: Cum tua centenos expunget sportula civis,

passages.label: Mart. 13.123.2
passages.text: Fumea Massiliae ponere vina potes.

passages.label: Mart. 13.124.1
passages.text: Caeretana Nepos ponat, Setina putabis.

passages.label: Mart. 13.124.2
passages.text: Non ponit turbae, cum tribus illa bibit.

passages.label: Mart. 13.125.1
passages.text: Nobilis et lanis et felix vitibus Aulon

passages.label: Mart. 13.125.2
passages.text: Det pretiosa tibi vellera, vina mihi.

passages.label: Mart. 13.126.1
passages.text: Unguentum heredi numquam nec vina relinquas.

passages.label: Mart. 13.126.2
passages.text: Ille habeat nummos, haec tibi tota dato.

passages.label: Mart. 13.127.1
passages.text: Dat festinatas, Caesar, tibi bruma coronas:

passages.label: Mart. 13.127.2
passages.text: Quondam veris erat, nunc tua facta rosa est.
